lines: Ashwini Amit Dixit, Promoter Group Selling Shareholder, may sell up to ₹9.13 crore via 67,500 shares in the offer for sale.
Proceeds are up to ₹9.13 crore if all offered shares are sold; employee-portion shares sell at a discount, so actual proceeds are slightly lower.
Retained value is an estimate of ₹64.08 crore at offer price; average cost of acquisition is unknown, so gain is unknown.
Shares unlocked on 9 Sep 2026, 66 days ago; the money is in hand since 11 Mar 2026, 8 months ago. Family link: shares surname Dixit with Amit Arun Dixit.
